headline: China Prepares Shenzhen for APEC Leaders Summit in Mid-November
summary: Shenzhen entered its final preparations to host the APEC leaders meeting on November 18-19, as the United States and Russia weigh a possible bilateral leaders encounter during the event.
why: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum brings together economies accounting for the majority of global trade, often serving as a venue for high-stakes bilateral diplomacy and trade negotiations.
